title: Rental-Load Months in an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Payment Arrangement
content:
**Clause.** Rental-load months are added to the term of a new Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility payment arrangement according to the patient's ongoing monthly rentals, counting each of the wheelchair line (Mobility Equipment), the oxygen line (Home Oxygen Therapy) and the PAP device line (PAP Therapy Equipment) with a paid rental month whose service-from date falls fewer than 2 whole calendar months before the handling date: two or more such rentals add 2 months; exactly one adds 1 month; none adds none.

| Lines with a paid rental month in the window | Months added to the arrangement term |
|---|---|
| 2 or 3 | 2 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 0 | 0 |

**Window (hypothetical dates).** Handling date 12 October: a paid month with a service-from date of 1 September (1 whole month before) counts; one dated 1 August (2 whole months before) does not.

**Case (hypothetical).** A patient whose oxygen and PAP device months for September were both paid, and whose wheelchair is owned: 2 lines, 2 months added.
